coveredBehaviours: the nine-step workflow is bound to the verified candidate, product source and migration set
the selected FIDE mode, pairing system and TRF version must be declared by the candidate
every required screen has English-label assertions and identity hashes for its screen and help topic
the workflow state hash is continuous from FIDE-mode activation through recovery
only rating import, tournament creation, player registration, pairing and result entry may commit
only pairing generation may call the declared engine and no step may use a legacy or manual fallback
standings, export and recovery are read-only in this synthetic acceptance path
no step may publish live output and no personal identifiers are accepted in the evidence batch
GO does not claim that the verifier executed or visually inspected the product
